EXPERIENCES WITH GENERAL CELLULAR AND NEURAL CELLULAR PATHOLOGY IN A CASE BASED BLENDED LEARNING ECOSYSTEM'S CBBLE"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;I'm SHAIK SAMEER, a under graduate medical student from Telangana, India.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI m here to share my experience that i have learned in the past years under the guidence of my beloved professor of general medicine.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); text-size-adjust: 100%;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: trebuchet;\"\u003ECBBLE PAJR PARTICIPATORY LEARNING ACTION RESEARCH DISCLAIMER\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-size: 15px; text-size-adjust: 100%;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: trebuchet;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-size: 15px; text-size-adjust: 100%;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: trebuchet;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;NOTE: THIS IS AN ONLINE E LOGBOOK TO DISCUSS OUR PATIENT'S DE-IDENTIFIED HEALTH DATA SHARED AFTER TAKING HIS\/HER GUARDIAN'S SIGNED INFORMED CONSENT. HERE WE DISCUSS OUR INDIVIDUAL PATIENT'S PROBLEMS THROUGH A SERIES OF INPUTS FROM THE AVAILABLE GLOBAL ONLINE COMMUNITY OF EXPERTS INTENDING TO SOLVE THOSE CLINICAL PROBLEMS WITH COLLECTIVE CURRENT BEST EVIDENCE-BASED INPUT.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMY FIRST PATIENT INTERACTION\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI FIRST INTERACTED WITH MY PATIENT IN THE AMC WARD.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHE WAS SEVERELY DEHYDRATED AND WAS IN SEVERE PAIN.SO I WENT NEAR HIM AND ENQUIRED ABOUT HIS MEDICAL CONDITION.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI HAVE TAKEN A DETAILED HISTORY FROM THE PATIENT TO FIND OUT THE EXACT CAUSE AND THE CONDITION HE IS FACING.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFROM\u0026nbsp; THE HISTORY I GOT TO KNOW THAT HE WAS A ALCOHOLIC AND WAS TAKING ALCOHOL FROM PAST THREE DAYS BEFORE THE PATIENT GOT ADMITTED .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EON THE THIRD DAY OF HIS ALCOHOL PARTY HE GOT SEVERE PAIN IN THE EPIGASTRIC REGION WHICH WAS SQUEEZING TYPE AND PAIN SEVERITY GRADUALLY INCREASED WITH TIME . HE ALSO HAD 8 EPISODES OF VOMITING ON THAT DAY. SO HE WS BROUGHT TO OUR HOSPITAL BY HIS FAMILY MEMBERS .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFROM THE HISTORY I GOT TO KNOW THAT PAIN IN THE EPIGASTRIC REGION\u0026nbsp; MAY BE DUE TO ALCOHOL IRRITATION .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHERE MY THEORETICAL KNOWLEDGE HELPED ME TO THINK ABOUT VARIOUS POSSIBILITE OF ALCOHOL CAUSING PAIN.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETHEN ON MY FURTHER INTERACTION WITH THE PATIENT I HAVE DONE\u0026nbsp; GENERAL AND PHYSICAL EXAMINATION BY TAKING CONCENT FROM THE PATIENT\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EON DOING GENERAL AND PHYSICAL EXAMINATION AND PROPER HISTORY TAKING I AM ABLE TO FILTER OUT MOST OF THE CONDITIONS AND ONLINE DISCUSSIONS ABOUT THIS CONDITION ALSO HELPED ME TO LERN MORE ABOUT THIS CONDITION AND COMPLICATIONS THAT CAN OCCUR.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETHANKS TO MY PROFESSOR FOR TEACHING ME THE IMPORTANCE OF TAKING DETAILED HISTORY AND EXAMINATION AND MAKING ME A BETTER STUDENT.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHere is the link of the blog of this patient.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/sameer204.blogspot.com\/2022\/03\/this-is-online-e-log-book-to-discuss.html\u003C\/p\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/sameer204.blogspot.com\/feeds\/2796574621296311041\/comments\/default","title":"Post Comments"},{"rel":"replies","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/sameer204.blogspot.com\/2023\/06\/shaik-sameer-under-graduate-medical.html#comment-form","title":"1 Comments"},{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/2244476608567274691\/posts\/default\/2796574621296311041"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/2244476608567274691\/posts\/default\/2796574621296311041"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/sameer204.blogspot.com\/2023\/06\/shaik-sameer-under-graduate-medical.html","title":"MY EXPERIENCES WITH GENERAL CELLULAR AND NEURAL CELLULAR PATHOLOGY IN A CASE BASED BLENDED LEARNING ECOSYSTEM'S CBBLE"}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"SHAIK SAMEER ROLL NO 204"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/08143979897615686996"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}],"thr$total":{"$t":"1"}}]}}
